hike.label: Bond yields
hike.why: New debt must pay more; the short end jumps hardest.

hike.label: US Dollar
hike.why: Banks park cash where risk-free yield is highest.

hike.label: Gold
hike.why: Real yields rise — bonds out-compete gold as the inflation hedge.

hike.label: Stocks
hike.why: Can grind higher until something breaks; watch the curve.

hike.label: Yield curve
hike.why: Overnight-rate pressure on the short end — the historic recession precursor.

cut.label: Bond yields
cut.why: Cheaper money; existing bonds rally as yields fall.

cut.label: US Dollar
cut.why: Yield advantage evaporates; capital hunts returns elsewhere.

cut.label: Gold
cut.why: Real yields fall — gold wins the safe-haven contest.

cut.label: Stocks
cut.why: Cheap credit → borrowing → earnings → risk appetite (once the reason for cutting passes).

cut.label: Yield curve
cut.why: Short end drops first; steepening after inversion is the classic recession confirmation.

hold.label: Bond yields
hold.why: Direction inherits from the expectation trend, not the meeting.

hold.label: US Dollar
hold.why: Follows the next expected move — watch the two dials.

hold.label: Gold
hold.why: Tracks real-yield expectations while the Fed waits.

hold.label: Stocks
hold.why: Structural upward skew persists absent a shock.

hold.label: Yield curve
hold.why: Shape set by which move markets price next.
